items.summary: rmagine: tests/cuda/public_headers.cpp:1-8 claims the installed headers are includable 'in any order'; the single-TU test cannot prove that and two of the 16 (math/linalg.cuh, util/cuda/CudaHelper.hpp) fail standalone as pre-existing upstream defects. Tighten the comment, and optionally add a per-header TU gate plus the two two-line upstream fixes (<stdexcept>, runtime include). Deferred because it needs a fork commit and a fifth revalidation round across four completed platforms.
